now.title: Avengers: Endgame
now.text: Morgan Stark is Howard Stark's granddaughter, born to his son Tony and Pepper Potts long after Howard's death.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Howard's granddaughter, born long after his death.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Morgan's grandfather, who died long before she was born.

changes.evidence: A blood tie never met. Howard Stark is killed in 1991 (Captain America: Civil War), and Morgan Stark is born in 2019 to Tony and Pepper (Avengers: Endgame). They never share a scene; the MCU wiki lists Howard only as her paternal grandfather in the relationship list, with no on-screen dealing between them in either page.
